title: Chamber bands
description: Estimated chamber temperature bands from research, for materials whose sources publish no chamber window. A band is inference: it is shown beside the chamber question, never decides a gate (D6, D34), and is superseded where a source publishes a window or says no heated chamber is needed. A no-band row records a material deliberately given none, and why.

fields.name: Kind
fields.description: band: an estimated band; no-band: deliberately none.

fields.name: Basis
fields.description: What the band was inferred from, or why there is none.

fields.name: Source
fields.description: The research report the band comes from.
